patch_description: This crossover keeps the current program’s direct-link rewards and sparse, demand-adaptive relay selection, while borrowing the inspiration program’s simple path-support weighting. Relay candidates are ranked using both geometric strength of the two route legs and the relay’s incident-demand pressure, so a strong single leg is less likely to dominate a weak route. A low-pressure alternative is retained among the selected relays to add some diversity. The implementation also accumulates repeated couplings rather than overwriting them and handles non-finite inputs. The degree penalty remains external; the returned penalty weight is set modestly above the current value.
